items.title: OpenAI rewrites ChatGPT Business Hub terms after legal language raises concerns
items.excerpt: OpenAI revised its ChatGPT Business Hub terms after concerns that the original language could restrict businesses' legal claims — a new action on the hub brands use to manage how they appear and advertise in ChatGPT.

items.title: In Graphic Detail: Welcome to the agentic commerce quarter
items.excerpt: OpenAI, Google, Amazon and Walmart are betting on agent-led holiday shopping; Digiday charts how far agentic commerce still has to go heading into Black Friday.

items.title: Anthropic says no to ads but Wall Street may have other ideas
items.excerpt: Post-IPO, Anthropic has shareholders, a huge compute bill and a costly free tier, so its pledge to keep ads out of Claude may have a shelf life — a question for advertisers eyeing AI-assistant inventory.

items.title: Canvas Worldwide's Agentic Layer Helps Zillow Distinguish Real Renters From Dreamers
items.excerpt: Canvas Worldwide's AI agent layer optimizes campaign budgeting and pacing for clients like Zillow, separating high-intent renters from browsers.

items.title: Measuring Clicks Is Making ChatGPT Ads Look Like A Bad Bet
items.excerpt: The ChatGPT ads debate has become a comparison with Google search, but judging conversational AI ads on clicks misreads how they drive incremental outcomes (Incrmntal's CEO argues).

items.title: Agentic Advertising in practice at our International Summit
items.excerpt: IAB Tech Lab recaps its London International Summit sessions on agentic advertising in practice — agents in buying workflows, CTV and server-side ad tech.

items.title: CJ메조미디어, AI 기반 광고 예측·분석 체계 완성… 예산 최적화 솔루션 '버짓옵트 2.0' 출시
items.excerpt: CJ메조미디어가 통합광고 플랫폼 '애들리'에 22개 업종별 머신러닝 모델로 광고주 자체 데이터 없이도 예산 배분안을 제시하는 '버짓옵트 2.0'을 출시했다. 자체 AI 에이전트 '스핀엑스'가 분석 결과와 배분 근거를 설명한다.

items.title: KPR 'AI 전환' 본격화…AI 합성 패널 '인사이트Q'·콘텐츠 논란 점검 '인사이트렌즈' 공개
items.excerpt: KPR이 AI 합성 패널로 설문 없이 소비자 반응을 확인하는 '인사이트Q'와 게시 전 콘텐츠의 논란 요소를 AI가 점검하는 '인사이트렌즈'를 공개했다.

items.title: "마케터 97%, AI 활용 계획" 광고 업무별 실제 도입률은 30~40% 수준
items.excerpt: DoubleVerify의 2026 글로벌 인사이트 보고서(마케터 2,020명 조사): 97%가 광고 업무에 AI를 쓸 계획이지만 미디어 브리프 요약 37%, 캠페인 집행 35%, 입찰 최적화 29% 등 업무별 실제 도입률은 30~40% 수준이다.

items.title: Walmart mulls role advertising will play in an agentic shopping world
items.excerpt: Momentum for Walmart's ad business remains strong, but executives acknowledged that AI agents are producing different consumer behaviors, raising the question of where advertising fits in agentic shopping.

items.title: Model sues RomperJack after 2021 photos became AI-generated Instagram ads
items.excerpt: Paid in clothes with no signed release, model Jeffrey Stanfield says RomperJack's new owner turned his 2021 shoot into AI-generated video ads on Instagram — testing whether old photo licenses cover synthetic performances.

items.title: Loblaw lets Meta's Muse plan meals and check out groceries in Canada
items.excerpt: Loblaw becomes the first Canadian retail connector for Meta's Muse AI agent, which plans meals and checks out grocery baskets; Google adds Loblaw audiences to DV360 the same day.

items.title: Amazon's ad agent can't see why three campaigns stopped serving
items.excerpt: An advertiser's three campaigns hit zero impressions from Nov 15, yet Amazon's AI ads agent — sold on troubleshooting — said bids, budgets and status were out of its reach.

items.title: Bing & Microsoft Ads With Made With AI Label
items.excerpt: Microsoft is now showing a "Made with AI" label in the corner of AI-generated images on some ads across Microsoft Advertising and Bing Search.

items.title: Microsoft Ads In AI Overviews on Bing
items.excerpt: Microsoft confirmed on the Microsoft Advertising blog that it now shows ads inside AI Overviews in Bing Search, after ads were spotted there about three weeks ago.

items.title: Google, ChatGPT & Others With Coupon Codes Directly In The AI Answers
items.excerpt: Ahead of the holidays, Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT and other AI engines now surface merchant coupon and promo codes directly in answers, bypassing coupon sites.

items.title: Mall of America debuts AI-backed concierge, Mallie
items.excerpt: Mall of America launched Mallie, an AI digital concierge that helps shoppers plan and personalize visits to North America's largest mall ahead of the holiday rush.

items.title: Snapchat enables Lens creation via third-party AI tools
items.excerpt: Snapchat's new Easy Lens capability lets users and brands build AR Lenses using their chatbot of choice.

items.title: 카페24 "AI 경유 쇼핑 주문, 1년 새 4배 증가…자사몰 AI 접근성 높여야"
items.excerpt: 카페24 자사몰 데이터 분석 결과 올해 3분기 주요 AI 서비스를 거쳐 유입된 방문은 전년 대비 2배 이상, 주문은 약 4배 늘었다. AI 유입 고객의 상세페이지 직행 비중은 포털 검색 대비 약 2배, 전환율은 약 2.5배 높았다.

items.title: 수호아이오 "AI 에이전트가 발주·결제하려면 거래 검증 인프라 필요"
items.excerpt: 수호아이오는 AI 에이전트가 소상공인을 대신해 발주·결제하려면 재고·물류·결제 서비스를 연결하고 에이전트가 주인 권한 안에서 거래했는지 검증하는 인프라가 필요하다고 밝혔다.

items.title: [SFF2026] 이은미 토스뱅크 대표 "AI에 집·자동차 구매 맡길 수 있나…권한과 책임 명확해야"
items.excerpt: 이은미 토스뱅크 대표는 AI 에이전트 결제 확산을 위해 에이전트 신원 확인과 권한·책임 범위 설정 등 신뢰 장치가 기술보다 중요하다고 강조했다.
